columns.name: Company And Position
columns.valueCondition:
const companyData=this.placementDriveCompanyAndPosition||{};const rows=[companyData.position&&`
Position: ${companyData.position}
`,(companyData.minSalary||companyData.maxSalary)&&`
Salary: ${companyData.minSalary||""}${companyData.maxSalary?" - "+companyData.maxSalary:""} ${companyData.currency||""}
`,companyData.jobDescription&&`
Job Description: ${companyData.jobDescription}
`,companyData.jobLocation&&`
Job Location: ${companyData.jobLocation}
`,companyData.jobType&&`
Job Type: ${companyData.jobType}
`].filter(Boolean).join("");const htmlString=rows?`
${rows}
`:"";return htmlString;

columns.name: Eligibility Criteria
columns.valueCondition:
const eligibility=this.placementDriveEligibility||{};const rows=[eligibility.mincgpa&&`
Min CGPA: ${eligibility.mincgpa}
`,(eligibility.maxBacklogs||eligibility.maxBacklogs===0)&&`
Max Backlogs: ${eligibility.maxBacklogs}
`,eligibility.requiredSkills?.length&&`
Required Skills: ${eligibility.requiredSkills.join(", ")}
`,eligibility.eligibleSemesters?.length&&`
Eligible Semesters: ${eligibility.eligibleSemesters.join(", ")}
`,eligibility.eligibleBranches?.length&&`
Eligible Branches: ${eligibility.eligibleBranches.join(", ")}
`].filter(Boolean).join("");const htmlString=rows?`
${rows}
`:"";return htmlString;

const schedule=this.placementDriveSchedule||{},tz="Asia/Kolkata",fmt=iso=>iso?new Date(iso).toLocaleString("en-IN",{timeZone:tz,year:"numeric",month:"short",day:"2-digit",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"}):"",rows=[schedule.driveDate&&`
Drive Date: ${fmt(schedule.driveDate)}
`,schedule.registrationDeadline&&`
Registration Deadline: ${fmt(schedule.registrationDeadline)}
`,schedule.testDate&&`
Test Date: ${fmt(schedule.testDate)}
`,schedule.interviewRounds?.length&&`
Interview Rounds:
    ${schedule.interviewRounds.map(r=>`
  • ${r.name}${r.date?` - ${fmt(r.date)}`:""}${r.type?.length?` (${r.type.join(", ")})`:""}
    • `).join("")}
`].filter(Boolean).join("");const htmlString=rows?`
${rows}
`:"";return htmlString;
